senses.gloss:
(ई) शुरी r. 4th cl. (शूर्य्यते)
1 To hurt, to kill.
2 To be stupid or insensible; also शूर.

m. (-रः)
A lion.
E.
शुर to injure, aff. क.

r. 10th cl. (शूरयते)
1 To be valiant or powerful.
2 To make great effort or exertion.
(ई) शूरी r. 4th cl. (शूर्य्यते)
1 To hurt or kill.
2 To be stupid.

m. (-रः)
1 A hero.
2 The sun.
3 A lion.
4 A boar.
5 The grandfather of KṚṢṆA.
6 The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.)
E.
शु to bear, Sautra root, Uṇādi aff. क्रन्, and the vowel made long, or शूर to be brave, aff. अच्.

r. 6th cl. (सुरति)
1 To possess supreme or superhuman power.
2 To shine.

(ई) षूरी r. 4th cl. (सूर्य्यते)
1 To be stopped or fixed.
2 To hurt or kill.

r. 6th cl. (सुरति)
1 To possess supreme or superhuman power.
2 To shine; also षुर.

m. (-रः)
1 A god, a deity.
2 The sun.
3 A sage, a learned man.
f. (-रा-री)
1 Spirituous liquor in general personified: also as a nymph, produced at the churning of the ocean.
2 A drinking vessel.
3 A snake.
E.
षु to possess power, Uṇādi aff. रक्, or षुर to be radiant, क affix, or सुरा wine (whose, that falling to the share of the gods,) or सु excellent, राज to shine, aff. ड, &c.

(ई) सूरी r. 4th cl. (सूर्य्यते)
1 To hurt or kill.
2 To be stupid or dull.

m. (-रः)
1 The sun.
2 The father of the 17th Jaina of the present era.
3 A Paṇḍita, a learned man.
f. (-री)
Black mustard.
E.
षू to bring forth, क्रन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-णः)
1 An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum, Rox.)
2 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
E.
शूरी to hurt, (some diseases,) aff. युच्.

m. (-णः)
An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum.)
E.
सूर to hurt, aff. ल्युट्; also शूरण.

m. (-जः)
A kind of bird.
E.
शूरण the Arum, and उद् before भुज to eat, aff. क.

f. (-ता)
Heroism, prowess.
E.
तल् added to शूर; also with त्व, शूरत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Compassionate, tender.
n. (-तं)
Copulation, coition.
f. (-ता)
Godhead, divinity.
E.
सु well, रम to sport or play, aff. क्त, or सुर a deity, and तल् aff. of state or condition.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Compassionate, tender.
2 Tranquil, calm.
E.
सु well, रम to sport or rest, क्त Uṇādi aff., and the vowel of the prefix made long; also सुरत.

m. (-वः)
The second Jina of the future era.

n. (-नं)
Vaunting, pride of prowess.
E.
शूर, and मान pride.

m. (-नी)
A boaster, one who thinks himself a hero.
E.
शूर, and मन to think, णिनि aff.

m. (-न्यः)
A boaster, one who thinks himself a hero
E.
शूर, and मन to think, खश् aff.

m. (-नः)
1 The country about Mathura.
2 The name of a prince.
E.
शूर a hero, सेना an army.

r. 10th cl. (शूर्पयति)
To mete or measure.

mn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पं)
1 A winnowing basket.
2 A measure of two Droṇas.
f. (-र्प्पी)
A small kind of winnowing basket, a toy for children.
2 The sister of RĀVAṆA: see शूर्प्पनखा.
E.
शृ to injure, Uṇādi aff. प, and ऊ substituted for the vowel.

mn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पं)
A winnowing basket.
E.
सूर्प्प to measure, aff. घञ्; or शृ to injure, प Uṇādi aff., and the vowel and initial changed: this word and its compounds are hence more usually written शूर्प्प, &c. q. v.

m. (-कः)
A demon, the enemy of KĀMADEVA.
E.
शूर्प्प to measure, aff. ण्वुल्.

m. (-र्णः)
An elephant.
E.
शूर्प्प a winnowing basket, and कर्ण the ear.

m. (-तिः)
KĀMA or CUPID.
E.
शूर्प्पक a demon, and अराति an enemy; also शूर्प्पकारि, &c.

f. (-खा)
The sister of the Daitya RĀVAṆA.
E.
शूर्प्प a winnowing basket, and नख a finger nail, (having them as large,) fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्, whence also शूर्प्पनस्वी.

f. (-खा)
The sister of RĀVAṆA.
E.
सूर्प्प, and नख a nail.

m. (-वः)
A measure (a basket) of winnowed corn.
E.
शूर्प्प, and निष्पाव winnowing.

f. (-र्णी)
A sort of bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.)

m. (-तः)
The air as agitated by the shaking of the winnowing basket.
E.
शूर्प्प a basket, and वात wind.

m. (-तिः)
An elephant.
E.
शूर्प्प a winnowing basket, and श्रुति an ear; as large.

m. (-र्म्मः)
An iron image, &c.: see the next.

mf. (-र्म्मिः-र्म्मी)
1 An iron image.
2 An anvil.
E.
शु for शोभा beauty, and उर्म्मि a wave or line, ङीष् optionally added; deriv. irr.: also with इ rejected, and कन् added, fem. form शूर्म्मिका; again, as differently read, सूर्म्मि, स्युर्म्मि, &c.

f. (-र्म्मिः-र्म्मी)
1 An image of metal, chiefly of iron.
2 The pillar of a house.
E.
श changed to स, see शूर्म्मी.

r. 1st cl. (सूर्क्षति)
1 To respect, to regard, to treat with reverence or respect.
2 To disregard, to disrespect.

r. 1st cl. (सूर्क्ष्यति)
1 To envy, to be impatient of another's rise.
2 To be intolerant or impatient of another's faults.
3 To disregard or contemn.

r. 1st cl. (सूर्क्ष्यति)
1 To envy, to be impatient of another's success.
2 To be intolerant; also षूर्क्ष्य.

m. (-र्क्ष्यः)
A kind of bean, (Phaseolus radiatus.)
E.
सूर्क्ष to disrespect, यत् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Deeply or well coloured or dyed.
2 Deep red, crimson.
3 Strongly affected or impassioned.
E.
सु well, रञ्ज to dye, &c., aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
1 A variety of red chalk, that called golden.
2 A fruit tree, apparently a sort of mango, bearing a small red fruit.
E.
सुरक्त very red, and कन् added.

n. (-णं)
Taking good care of, protecting, preserving.
E.
सु, and रक्षण preserving.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well-preserved or protected.
E.
सु well, रक्षित preserved.

m. (-णः)
A class or company of divinities.
E.
सुर, and गण a number.

m. (-रुः)
VṚHASPATI, regent of Jupiter and preceptor of the gods.
E.
सुर a deity, and गुरु spiritual preceptor.

m. (-णीः)
INDRA, the ruler of Svarga.
E.
सुर a god, and ग्रामणी leader.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 The orange.
2 Bright or good colour or dye.
n. (-ङ्गं)
1 Red sanders.
2 Vermilion.
f. (-ङ्गा)
A hole cut in a wall to break into a house, &c.; see सुरुङ्गा.
2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.)
3 Crystal.
E.
सु well, and रङ्ग colour.

n. (-दं)
Red sanders.
E.
सुरङ्ग good colour, and द what yields.

m. (-तुः)
Red chalk.
E.
सुरङ्ग good or much colour, and धातु a mineral.

m. (-युक्)
A house-breaker.
E.
सुरङ्ग a hole in a wall, and युज् who joins or makes.

m. (-लः)
The jack-fruit tree.
E.
सुरजस् abundant farina, and फल fruit.

f. (-नी)
Night.
E.
सु well, रजनी the same.

m. (-ष्ठः)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
सुर a deity, and ज्येष्ठ elder.

m. (-नः)
The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.)
E.
सु well, and रञ्जन pleasing, affecting.

f. (-ली)
1 A female messenger, a go-between.
2 A chaplet, a garland for the head.
E.
सुरत coition, and ताल tune, &c., aff. ङीष्.

m. (-कः)
The jewel worn by KṚṢṆA on his breast.
E.
सुर a deity, तुष to please, खुल् aff.

n. (-रु)
A sort of Pine, (Pinus Devadaru.)
E.
मुर a deity, and दारु wood.

सुरदीर्घिका^1
f. (-का)
The Ganges of heaven.
E.
सुर a god, and दीर्घिका a pond or pool.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20230605. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/1229.

m. (-पः)
An elephant of the gods, either that of INDRA or of either of the other rulers of the different quarters.
E.
सुर a god, and द्विप an elephant.

m. (-द्विट्)
An Asura, an infernal being, the natural enemy of the gods.
E.
सुर a deity, and द्विष् an enemy.

m. (-मः)
The Deodar Pine.
E.
सुर, and द्रुम a tree.

n. (-नुः)
The rain-bow.
E.
सुर a god, and धनुस् a bow; the bow of INDRA.

m. (-पः)
Resin, turpentine.
E.
सुर a god, and धूप incense.

f. (-दी)
The Ganges of heaven.
E.
सुर a god, and नदी a river.

f. (-गा)
The Ganges.
E.
सुर a deity, and निम्नगा a river.

f. (-ला)
A river so named.

m. (-तिः)
INDRA, ruler of Svarga, and sovereign of the gods.
E.
सुर a deity, and पति master.

n. (-थं)
Sky, heaven.
E.
सुर a deity, and पथिन् a path.

n. (-र्णं)
A drug, probably a leaf, commonly called Machi perṇi, and described as pungent and bitter, anthelmintic, stomachic, and a remover of phlegm and catarrh.
E.
सुर a deity, and पर्ण a leaf.

f. (-का)
A tree, (Rottleria tinctoria.)
E.
कन् fem. form added to the last.

f. (-री)
The capital of INDRA.
E.
सुर a god, and पुरी a city.

m. (-यः)
1 INDRA.
2 VṚHASPATI, the preceptor of the gods.
3 The Elœocarpus.
E.
सुर a deity, and प्रिय beloved by.

mfn. (-भिः-भिः or भी-भि)
1 Fragrant, sweet-smelling.
2 Pleasing, beloved.
3 Friendly, a friend.
4 Celebrated, famous.
5 Wise, learned.
6 Handsome.
7 Good, virtuous.
m. (-भिः)
1 A fragrance, a perfume, a sweet-smelling substance.
2 The Michelia Champaca.
3 Nutmeg.
4 Spring.
5 The month Chaitra, (March-April.)
6 Resin.
f. (-भिः or भी)
1 The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
2 Murā, a sort of drug and perfume.
3 One of the divine Mātṛs.
4 A cow.
5 A fabulous cow, the cow of plenty, granting every wish.
6 Spirituous liquor.
7 The earth.
8 A holy basil.
9 Jasmine, of several sorts.
n. (-भि)
1 Gold.
2 Sulphur.
E.
सु well, excellently, रभ to begin, इन् aff.

mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि)
Fragrant, sweet-smelling.
E.
सुरभि fragrant, गन्ध smell, इ substituted for the final.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Perfumed, rendered fragrant.
E.
सुरभि, and इतच् aff.

n. (-त्वक्)
Large cardamoms.
E.
सुरभि fragrant, त्वच् bark.

n. (-लं)
The Laurus Cassia, or its bark.
E.
सुरभि fragrant, and वल्कल bark.

m. (-णः)
KĀMA.
E.
सुरभि a fragrance, a flower, and वाण an arrow.

f. (-वा)
The gum Olibanum tree.
E.
सुरभि a fragrance, and स्रव what distils.

f. (-चा)
The rose-apple, (Eugenia jambu.)
E.
सुरभी fragrant, and पचा leaved.

f. (-सा)
The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
E.
सुरभी fragrant, रस juice, टाप् added.

n. (-यं)
The condition of a deity, deification, apotheosis.
E.
सुर, and भूय becoming.

m. (-र्षिः)
A Ṛṣi, or sage of divine order, as NĀRADA, &c.
E.
सुर a deity, and ऋषि a saint.

f. (-ला)
1 The Ganges.
2 Another river so named.
E.
सुर a deity, and ला to get or have, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

m. (-कः)
Svarga, the heaven of INDRA, and residence of the celestials.
E.
सुर a deity, and लोक world.

n. (-र्त्म)
Heaven, sky, ether, atmosphere.
E.
सुर a divinity, and वर्त्मन् a road.

m. (-द्विट्)
An Asura, a titan.
E.
सुर, and विद्विष् foe.

m. (-री)
An Asura, an infernal spirit.
E.
सुर a city, and वैरिन् an enemy.

m. (-त्रुः)
An Asura, an infernal spirit.
E.
सुर a deity, and शत्रु an enemy.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
1 Sweet.
2 Well-flavoured, sapid, juicy.
3 Elegant, (as a composition.)
m. (-सः)
A plant, (Vitex trifolia.)
nf. (-सं-सा)
Holy basil.
f. (-सा)
1 The mother of the Nāgas.
2 A plant, commonly Rasan, a kind of Ophiorrhiza, (Ophiorrhiza mangos.)
3 A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa.)
4 The moon-plant, (Asclepias acida.)
5 A name of DURGĀ.
6 A species of the Atidhṛti metre.
n. (-सं)
1 Gum myrrh.
2 Cassia bark.
3 Fragrant grass.
E.
सु excellent, रस juice or flavour.

m. (-ङ्घः)
A company, a number of gods.
E.
सुर, and सङ्घ a troop, &c.

n. (-द्म)
Svarga, the heaven of INDRA.
E.
सुर a deity, and सद्मन् a dwelling.

f. (-तिः)
An assemblage of the gods.
E.
सुर, and समिति assembling.

f. (-रित्)
The Ganges.
E.
सुर a deity, and सरित् a river.

m. (-ष्टः)
A class of eight plants, the Vitex trifolia, acid Asclepias, &c.
E.
सुरसा a juicy plant, and अष्ट eight.

f. (-न्धुः)
The river Ganges.
E.
सुर a deity, and सिन्धु a river.

f. (-री)
1 An Apsaras or courtesan of heaven.
2 A name of DURGĀ.
E.
सुर a deity, and सुन्दरी a beauty.

m. (-रः)
The cocoanut tree.
E.
सुरा vinous spirit or Toddy, and कर what makes.

f. (-ना)
An Apsaras or courtesan of heaven, a nymph, a sylph, a fairy.
E.
सुर a deity, and अङ्गना a female.

m. (-र्य्यः)
VṚHASPATI, regent of JUPITER, and preceptor of the gods.
E.
सुर a deity, and आचार्य्य a spiritual teacher.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Eclipta prostrata.)

m. (-जा)
A divinity.
E.
सु particle of eminence, राज to shine, aff. टाप् and अच्.

m. (-वः)
A distiller.
E.
सुरा, and आजीव livelihood.

m. (-वी)
A distiller.
E.
सुरा spirits, and जीविन् who lives by.

f. (-त्रिः)
A fine night.
E.
सु, and रात्रि night.

m. (-पः)
INDRA.
E.
सुर, and अधिप chief.

n. (-जं)
A tavern flag or sign.
E.
सुरा, and ध्वज a flag.

mfn. (-पः-पी-पं)
Drinking spirits.
(-पः-पा-पं)
1 Wise.
2 Pleasant, agreeable.
3 Preserving spirits.
E.
सुरा vinous liquor, or सुर a deity, पा to drink or cherish, with or without the prefix आङ्, and ठक् or क aff.

f. (-गा)
The Ganges.
E.
सुर a deity, and अपगा a river.

m. plu. (-णाः)
The inhabitants of eastern India.
E.
सुरा vinous liquor, and पान drinking; the final changed to ण.

n. (-नं)
1 Drinking spirituous liquors.
2 Eating any thing to excite thirst and promote drinking.
E.
सुरा spirits, and पान drinking.

mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि)
Drinking wine.
E.
सुरा, and पा to drink, णिनि aff.

mf. (-तः-ता-तं)
Drinking wine.
E.
सुरा and पीत drunk.

m. (-गः)
Yeast, barm.
E.
सुरा spirits, and भाग a part.

n. (-नं)
A wine cup.
E.
सुरा, and भाजन a vessel.

m. (-ण्डः)
The upper part or froth of vinous liquor during fermentation, yeast, barm.
E.
सुरा wine, and मण्ड scum.

m. (-रिः)
1 An Asura, an infernal being opposed to the gods.
2 A sprite, a goblin, a Piśāca or Yakṣa.
3 The chirp of the cricket.
E.
सुर a deity, and अरि an enemy.

n. (-नं)
Worshipping.
E.
सुरा, and अर्च्चन worshipping.

n. (-र्हं)
Gold.
E.
सुर a god, and अर्ह worthy.

m. (-यः)
1 The sacred mountain Meru, the extremity of the world's axis, and residence of the gods.
2 Svarga or paradise.
3 A tavern.
E.
सुर a deity, or सुरा spirituous liquor, and आलय abode.

m. (-ष्ट्रः)
A country on the western side of India, Surat.
E.
सु good, and राष्ट्र district.

nf. (-जं-जा)
A fragrant earth.
m. (-जः)
1 A sort of bean, a black variety of the Phaseolus Mungo.
2 A kind of poison.
E.
सुराष्ट्र Surat, and ज born or produced.

n. (-वं)
Spirituous liquor, the produce of rapid distillation.
E.
सुरा, and आसव spirits.

n. (-ह्वं)
A kind of Pine, (Pinus Devadaru.)
E.
सुर a deity, and आह्व appellation; being generally called the tree or timber of the gods, or देवद्रु, देवदारु; also सुराह्वय, &c.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.)
f. (-ङ्गा)
A hole made under ground, or through the walls of a building, for military or felonious purposes; a mine, a breach, &c.
E.
सु well, रञ्ज to be intent on, aff. अच्, and उ substituted for the radical vowel.

m. (-हिः)
A house-breaker.
E.
सुरुङ्गा a hole in the wall, and अहि a snake.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Sick, unwell.
E.
सु much, रुज sick.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
Prominent, standing well up or out.
E.
सु, and रूढ ascended.

mfn. (-पः-पा or -पी-पं)
1 Handsome, well-formed.
2 Wise, learned.
E.
सु excellent, and रूप form.

m. (-कः)
A horse of the colour of an ass.
E.
सु well, रूह to mount, क्वुन् aff.

m. (-ज्यः)
VṚHASPATI, teacher of the gods.
E.
सुर a deity, and इज्य a preceptor.

m. (-न्द्रः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
सुर a deity, and इन्द्र chief.

m. (-जित्)
GARUḌA.
E.
सुरेन्द्र INDRA, and जित् victor; having beaten off that deity, when pursued by him to recover the nectar which GARUḌA had stolen.

m. (-कः)
The heaven of INDRA.
E.
सुरेन्द्र, and लोक a region.

n. (-भं)
Tin.
E.
सु well, रेभ to sound, aff. अच्.

m. (-टः)
A sort of betel-nut tree, (Areca gracilis or triandra.)

m. (-रः)
ŚIVA, or a personification of him, especially as one of the eleven Rudras.
f. (-री)
1 The Ganges of heaven.
2 A name of DURGĀ.
E.
सुर a deity, and ईश्वर lord.

m. (-ष्टः)
1 A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.)
2 The Śāl tree.
3 A kind of Punnag or Rottleria.
f. (-ष्टा)
The moon-plant, (Asclepias acida.)
E.
सुर a deity, and इष्ट wished.

mf. (-राः)
An opulent person.
E.
सु very, रै wealth.

m. (-मः)
The sun.
E.
सुर a deity, and उत्तम best.

m. (-रः)
Sandal wood.
E.
सुर a deity, and उत्तर excellent.

m. (-दः)
The sea of spirituous liquor.
E.
सुरा wine, and उद water.

m. (-तः)
ARUṆA, the personification of the dawn, as the charioteer of the sun.
E.
सूर the sun, and सूत charioteer.

m. (-रिः)
1 A Paṇḍita, a learned man.
2 A title commonly given to Jaina teachers.
3 KṚṢṆA.
4 The sun.
E.
षू to bear, Uṇādi aff. कि.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Wise, learned.
m. (-री)
A Paṇḍita, a scholar, a learned man.
E.
सूर to injure, to dispel (ignorance, &c.), णिनि aff.

n. (-णं)
Disrespect, contumely, contempt.
E.
षूर्क्ष to treat with disrespect, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-र्य्यः)
1 The sun.
2 Gigantic swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea.)
3 The son of BALI.
f. (-र्य्या)
1 The wife of the sun.
2 A drug, a bitter gourd.
3 A new bride.
E.
सृ to go, (in the heavens,) क्यप् aff., form irr.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A gem, sometimes applied to crystal, but usually to a stone of fabulous existence and properties.
2 A tree, (Hibiscus phoeniceus,) the red sort.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and कान्त a gem.

f. (-न्तिः)
1 The flower of the Sesamum.
2 Sun-shine.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and कान्ति lustre.

m. (-लः)
Day.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and काल time.

m. (-हः)
1 The sun.
2 An eclipse of the sun.
3 The personified ascending and descending node, or KETU and RĀHU.
4 The bottom of a water-jar.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and ग्रह a planet; or seizing, laying hold of.

m. (-जः)
1 The monkey SUGRĪVA.
2 The hero KARṆA.
f. (-जा)
The Yamunā river.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and ज born.

m. (-यः)
1 KARṆA.
2 SUGRĪVA.
f. (-या)
The Jumna or Yamunā river.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and तनय child; also similar compounds, as सूर्य्यपुत्त्र, सूर्य्यसुत, &c.

n. (-जः)
The radiance or heat of the sun.
E.
सूर्य्य, and तेजस् light.

m. (-त्त्रः)
1 VARUṆA.
2 ŚANI or Saturn.
3 YAMA.
f. (-त्त्री)
1 Lightning.
2 The Yamunā river.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and पुत्त्र the child; applicable also to KARṆA, SUGRĪVA, &c.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Devoted to, or worshipping the sun especially.
m. (-क्तः)
A flower, (Pentapetes phoenicea.)
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and भक्त a flower.

m. (-कः)
1 A flower, (Pentapetes phœnicea.)
2 A worshipper of the sun.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-णिः)
1 A tree, (Hibiscus phoeniceus.)
2 The sunstone, a crystal lens or a fabulous sort of gem.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and मणि a jewel.

n. (-लं)
The orb or disc of the sun.
E.
सूर्य्य, and मण्डल circle.

f. (-ता)
A plant, (Cleome viscosa.)
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and लता a creeper.

f. (-ल्ली)
A plant, (Cleome pentaphylla.)
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and वल्ली a pedicle.

m. (-मः)
The passage of the sun from one sign to another.
E.
सूर्य्य, and सङ्क्रम going.

f. (-न्तिः)
The sun's entrance into a new sign.
E.
सूर्य्य, and सङ्क्रान्ति transit.

n. (-ज्ञं)
Saffron.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and सज्ञा appellation.

m. (-थिः)
The charioteer of the sun, ARUṆA or the personified dawn.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and सारथि a charioteer.

m. (-कः)
Sunshine.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and आलोक light.

m. (-र्त्त)
1 A plant, (Cleome viscosa.)
2 A sun-flower, (Helianthus indicus.)
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and आवर्त्त revolving.

n. (-णं)
Looking at the sun.
E.
सूर्य्य, and अवेक्षण looking at.

m. (-श्मा)
The sun gem.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and अश्मन् a stone.

m. (-श्वः)
A horse of the sun.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and अश्व a horse.

n. (-स्तं)
Sun-set.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and अस्त setting.

n. (-ह्वं)
1 Copper.
2 Gigantic swallow-wort.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and आह्व appellation.

m. (-मः)
Day of new moon, when the moon rises invisible.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, इन्दु the moon, सङ्गम conjunction.

m. (-ढः)
An evening guest, one who claims hospitality after sun set.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and ऊढ borne.

m. (-यः)
Sun-rise.
E.
सूर्य्य the sun, and उदय rising.
